route_finding.implementation: Each request starts with false. CONNECT send_request_headers.started sets both nested and proxy_tunnel observed flags in the same trace callback. JSON deep copies persist completed per-request values.
route_finding.limits: False means no new CONNECT was observed on this HTTP request; reused pooled tunnels need not CONNECT again. It does not establish direct traffic. environment selects configured HTTPX proxy rules; OS VPN/TUN and physical intermediaries remain unobservable.

coverage_finding.classification: Existing conservative scope policy combined with model-selected limited securities scope; not a wrong or unread demand ID.
coverage_finding.evidence: ID 4009 was in the frozen scope, read twice and explicitly claimed. scope [SZ:159278] lacks public, so complete_task_demands applies its pre-existing security-only branch and rejects universe_changed coverage.
coverage_finding.test_boundary: test_limited_security_scope_cannot_complete_account_wide_demand proves the conservative account case; test_public_submission_requires_action_and_explicit_demand_coverage proves completed public reports can leave demands uncovered. No dedicated contract/test found requiring a single-security public scope to auto-complete universe_changed.
coverage_finding.future_clarification: Document or test the public/single-candidate scope boundary. Auto-completion would require an explicit coverage-policy change; do not silently rewrite this historical receipt to make the matrix pass.
coverage_finding.snapshot_vs_live: At publication: 55 uncovered. Relevance routing then acknowledged 54 public_information demands; 2 routed and 52 awaiting_retry. The latter are unresolved relevance, not model retries and not 52 fully researched materials. 4009 remains uncovered.

source_isolation.boundary: Public raw documents acquired by an account may be shared; a nonempty source-owner field is not private scope. Source-link receipts prove metadata delivery only. Stored events do not contain every raw outbound prompt, so this is database/receipt plus code-path evidence, not packet-level proof.
